comment: Drug interactions cross-referenced from BNF, BNFc, Stockley's Drug Interactions, Lexicomp/UpToDate, SPS, and NICE CKS. Severity: contraindicated | major | moderate | minor. Descriptions and 'action' give the safest advice. Always verify in current BNF/BNFc before clinical decisions.

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk (antiplatelet and GI effects). Avoid combination where possible.
interactions.action: Avoid or use shortest duration; PPI if essential; monitor for bleeding.

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk. Avoid combination where possible.
interactions.action: Avoid or use with PPI and bleeding vigilance.

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk. Avoid combination where possible.
interactions.action: Avoid or use with PPI and bleeding vigilance.

interactions.description: Additive bleeding risk. Low-dose aspirin often intentional (e.g. post-MI); monitor INR and bleeding.
interactions.action: Continue only if indicated; monitor INR and bleeding; PPI if GI risk.

interactions.description: Amiodarone potentiates warfarin (CYP2C9). Risk of over-anticoagulation.
interactions.action: Reduce warfarin dose (often by ~30–50%); check INR within 1–2 weeks and frequently until stable.

interactions.description: Fluconazole inhibits warfarin metabolism. Increases INR and bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Reduce warfarin dose; check INR within few days and adjust.

interactions.description: Trimethoprim may potentiate warfarin. Monitor INR.
interactions.action: Check INR when starting/stopping trimethoprim; adjust warfarin if needed.

interactions.description: St John's wort induces CYP enzymes; reduces warfarin effect and increases thrombosis risk.
interactions.action: Avoid St John's wort with warfarin. If already combined, stop St John's wort and recheck INR.

interactions.description: PPIs may alter warfarin effect in some patients (variable).
interactions.action: Monitor INR when starting or stopping PPI.

interactions.description: DOACs (apixaban, rivaroxaban, etc.) plus NSAIDs: additive bleeding risk. BNF marks severe.
interactions.action: Avoid or use shortest duration; PPI if essential; assess bleeding risk (age, renal function).

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk. Use with caution or avoid.
interactions.action: Avoid if possible; if essential use lowest dose/shortest duration; PPI.

interactions.description: Increased bleeding risk. Use with caution or avoid.
interactions.action: Avoid if possible; if essential use lowest dose/shortest duration; PPI.

interactions.description: DOAC plus antiplatelet: severe bleeding risk. Often intentional short-term (e.g. post-ACS).
interactions.action: Minimise duration of combination per guidelines; use PPI; monitor for bleeding.

interactions.description: Trimethoprim increases methotrexate toxicity (blood dyscrasia, myelosuppression).
interactions.action: Avoid combination. Use alternative antibiotic (e.g. penicillin if not allergic).

interactions.description: Co-trimoxazole contains trimethoprim; markedly increases methotrexate toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid. Use alternative antibiotic.

interactions.description: NSAIDs can reduce methotrexate renal clearance; increased toxicity risk.
interactions.action: Use with caution; monitor FBC and LFT; consider spacing or lower NSAID dose.

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce lithium renal excretion; risk of lithium toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid if possible; if essential, check lithium level within days and reduce lithium dose.

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce lithium excretion; risk of toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid if possible; if essential, monitor lithium level and reduce dose.

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce lithium excretion; risk of toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid if possible; if essential, monitor lithium level and reduce dose.

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors can increase lithium levels (reduced renal clearance).
interactions.action: Check lithium level when starting ACEi; reduce lithium dose if level rises.

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors can increase lithium levels.
interactions.action: Check lithium level when starting; reduce lithium if needed.

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors can increase lithium levels.
interactions.action: Check lithium level when starting; reduce lithium if needed.

interactions.description: Thiazides reduce lithium excretion; high risk of lithium toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid combination. Use loop diuretic if diuretic needed; monitor lithium.

interactions.description: Risk of hyperkalaemia. Avoid potassium supplements/salt substitutes unless indicated and monitored.
interactions.action: Do not add potassium unless hypokalaemia; check U&E if adding.

interactions.description: Risk of hyperkalaemia.
interactions.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Risk of hyperkalaemia.
interactions.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Serotonin syndrome (life-threatening). Do not combine.
interactions.action: Do not combine. Allow washout: 2 weeks after MAOI before SSRI; 5 weeks after fluoxetine before MAOI.

interactions.description: Serotonin syndrome risk. Do not combine.
interactions.action: Allow 2 weeks after MAOI before starting sertraline.

interactions.description: Serotonin syndrome risk. Fluoxetine long half-life.
interactions.action: Allow 5 weeks after fluoxetine before MAOI (or 2 weeks after MAOI before fluoxetine).

interactions.description: Linezolid is a reversible MAOI; serotonin syndrome risk with SSRIs.
interactions.action: Avoid combination. Stop SSRI before linezolid if possible, or use alternative antibiotic; if essential, monitor for serotonin syndrome.

interactions.description: Increased risk of serotonin syndrome and seizures.
interactions.action: Use with caution; lowest effective dose; consider alternative analgesic (e.g. paracetamol/codeine); monitor.

interactions.description: Serotonin syndrome risk.
interactions.action: Use with caution; consider alternative analgesic; monitor.

interactions.description: Severe hyperkalaemia risk. Potassium-sparing diuretic plus supplement.
interactions.action: Do not add potassium supplements unless severe hypokalaemia and monitored.

interactions.description: Hyperkalaemia risk.
interactions.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Hyperkalaemia risk.
interactions.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Hyperkalaemia risk (potassium-sparing diuretic).
interactions.action: Avoid potassium supplements unless prescribed and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Severe hyperkalaemia risk.
interactions.action: Do not add potassium unless indicated and U&E monitored.

interactions.description: Ibuprofen can reduce antiplatelet effect of low-dose aspirin if taken before aspirin. Also GI bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Take aspirin at least 2 hours before ibuprofen, or use alternative (paracetamol/NSAID with PPI).

interactions.description: NSAID may reduce cardioprotective effect of aspirin; GI bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Consider timing or alternative; PPI if combination essential.

interactions.description: Omeprazole (CYP2C19 inhibitor) may reduce clopidogrel antiplatelet effect. Evidence mixed.
interactions.action: Prefer lansoprazole or pantoprazole for gastroprotection with clopidogrel; or separate dosing.

interactions.description: PPI may reduce clopidogrel efficacy. Prefer non-omeprazole PPI.
interactions.action: Use lansoprazole or pantoprazole if PPI needed with clopidogrel.

interactions.description: Clarithromycin increases statin levels (CYP3A4 inhibition); myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk.
interactions.action: Avoid with simvastatin/atorvastatin; use pravastatin or rosuvastatin, or temporarily stop statin.

interactions.description: Clarithromycin greatly increases simvastatin levels. Avoid.
interactions.action: Avoid combination. Use alternative antibiotic (e.g. amoxicillin) or pause simvastatin.

interactions.description: Carbamazepine induces metabolism; reduces contraceptive efficacy.
interactions.action: Use non-enzyme-inducing contraception (e.g. Mirena, depot) or 50 mcg oestrogen pill; barrier backup.

interactions.description: Rifampicin markedly reduces contraceptive efficacy.
interactions.action: Use alternative contraception (e.g. non-enzyme-inducing) or barrier method during and after rifampicin.

interactions.description: St John's wort reduces contraceptive efficacy; unplanned pregnancy reported.
interactions.action: Avoid St John's wort with hormonal contraception; use alternative (e.g. barrier) or stop St John's wort.

interactions.description: Amiodarone can increase digoxin levels.
interactions.action: Reduce digoxin dose (often 50%); check digoxin level and adjust.

interactions.description: Iodinated contrast can cause acute kidney injury; metformin clearance reduced; lactic acidosis risk.
interactions.action: Stop metformin before procedure per local protocol (e.g. 48 h); restart when eGFR stable.

interactions.description: Calcium chelates doxycycline; reduces absorption.
interactions.action: Space doxycycline and calcium by 2–3 hours.

interactions.description: Antacids (calcium, magnesium, aluminium) reduce doxycycline absorption.
interactions.action: Space doxycycline and antacid by 2–3 hours.

interactions.description: Increased GI ulcer and bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Use PPI if combination needed; use lowest dose/shortest duration.

interactions.description: Increased GI bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Use PPI; lowest dose/shortest duration.

interactions.description: Fluconazole increases simvastatin levels; myopathy risk.
interactions.action: Avoid or use low-dose fluconazole short-term; consider pravastatin/rosuvastatin.

interactions.description: Verapamil increases simvastatin levels (CYP3A4).
interactions.action: Limit simvastatin to 20 mg daily or use alternative statin.

interactions.description: Diltiazem increases simvastatin levels.
interactions.action: Limit simvastatin to 20 mg daily or use alternative statin.

interactions.description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase; azathioprine toxicity (myelosuppression) increased.
interactions.action: Reduce azathioprine to ~25% of usual dose; monitor FBC closely. Or use alternative (e.g. mercaptopurine with same caution).

interactions.description: NSAIDs can increase nephrotoxicity and reduce ciclosporin clearance.
interactions.action: Use with caution; monitor renal function; avoid if possible.

interactions.description: Macrolide raises INR (CYP inhibition) — bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Avoid or monitor INR closely; consider alternative antibiotic.

interactions.description: Raised INR via CYP3A4 inhibition.
interactions.action: Monitor INR; consider alternative.

interactions.description: Even topical/oral gel markedly raises INR.
interactions.action: Avoid; use alternative antifungal.

interactions.description: Amlodipine raises simvastatin exposure (myopathy risk).
interactions.action: Max simvastatin 20 mg with amlodipine.

interactions.description: CYP3A4 inhibition raises statin levels.
interactions.action: Avoid grapefruit juice with simvastatin.

interactions.description: Reduced MTX excretion — toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid high-dose aspirin; caution with analgesic doses.

interactions.description: Increased myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk.
interactions.action: Max simvastatin 20 mg with amiodarone.

interactions.description: Raised digoxin levels and AV block.
interactions.action: Reduce digoxin; monitor levels and ECG.

interactions.description: Raised digoxin levels; assay interference.
interactions.action: Monitor digoxin and potassium.

interactions.description: CYP2C19 inhibition reduces clopidogrel activation.
interactions.action: Prefer alternative; review antiplatelet need.

interactions.description: Additive GI bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Co-prescribe PPI if NSAID needed; monitor.

interactions.description: Increased GI bleeding risk.
interactions.action: Gastroprotection if combined; review need.

interactions.description: Additive QT prolongation.
interactions.action: Avoid combination.

interactions.description: Additive QT prolongation.
interactions.action: Avoid or ECG/electrolyte monitoring.

interactions.description: CYP3A4 inhibition — rhabdomyolysis risk (esp. simvastatin/atorvastatin).
interactions.action: Suspend statin during course or use non-interacting statin.

interactions.description: Hyperkalaemia risk (additive).
interactions.action: Monitor potassium, especially in renal impairment/elderly.

interactions.description: Significant hyperkalaemia risk.
interactions.action: Avoid in at-risk patients; monitor potassium.

interactions.description: Xanthine oxidase inhibition — profound myelosuppression.
interactions.action: Avoid or reduce mercaptopurine to ~25% with specialist input.

interactions.description: Raised phenytoin levels — toxicity.
interactions.action: Monitor phenytoin levels; adjust dose.

interactions.description: Raised carbamazepine — toxicity.
interactions.action: Avoid; use alternative antibiotic.

interactions.description: Raised theophylline — toxicity (seizures, arrhythmia).
interactions.action: Avoid or monitor levels and reduce dose.

interactions.description: Additive bradycardia/AV block/heart failure.
interactions.action: Avoid combination, especially IV.

interactions.description: Increased lactic acidosis risk with acute excess.
interactions.action: Counsel; caution in renal/hepatic impairment.

interactions.description: Profound hypotension.
interactions.action: Absolute contraindication.

interactions.description: Hyperkalaemia (trimethoprim is potassium-sparing).
interactions.action: Monitor potassium.

provenance.disclaimer: Decision-support aid for UK healthcare professionals only. Not a registered medical device. Always verify against current NICE CKS, BNF/BNFc and local policy.
provenance.coverageNote: Curated, non-exhaustive subset of clinically important interactions. A 'no interaction identified' result does NOT exclude an interaction — always check current BNF/BNFc/Stockley's.
